combo_label: Post & Letters × The Circus × Ancient Rome

entries.clue: Write back, as courtesy demands, once the letter has arrived.
Silver coin jingling in Roman purses, a day's wage for many
Bulky brown-paper package sent by post, too big to push through a door.
Hot air under a raised floor — Roman central heating at work
Circle spun at the waist, or leapt through when set alight
Tortoise of locked shields creeping toward enemy walls
Maned roarer the tamer holds off with a raised chair
Long poles strapped to the legs to walk head-high over a crowd
Tiny mirror-bright disc sewn in rows to make a costume glitter
Stout corrugated container, taped along the seams before it is sent.
